required_setup: bolt upright and self-supported in guide, securely head-held, deliberately not thread-engaged, no deliberate axial preload
axial_force_target_approval: explicit user approval on 2026-08-12 based on the accepted read-only manual axial-load calibration
hard_axial_cutoff_basis: existing operator-approved and physically commissioned CONTACT_SEARCH hard cutoff; applied symmetrically here so a wrong-sign response also stops

wrong_direction_detector.basis: reuses the operator-approved and read-only-validated CONTACT_SEARCH detector magnitude and persistence

controller.rejected_implementation_reason: Franky 1.1.4 initializes its Cartesian interpolation from O_T_EE_c, which may be stale after Pilot hand-guiding and can introduce an unintended lateral transient
controller.stiffness_basis: installed Franky 1.1.4 Python constructor defaults; base Z is force-constrained so translational stiffness applies only to unconstrained base X/Y
controller.motion_duration_basis: same three-second loaded phase used in the accepted manual axial-load calibration
controller.state_timeout_basis: reuses the physically commissioned CONTACT_SEARCH timeout
controller.force_command_note: Franky 1.1.4 applies the selected force constraint directly
controller.exponential_decay_basis: installed Franky 1.1.4 default; target equals the measured initial pose, so no intentional pose transition is requested
controller.external_planned_duration_stop_basis: the first physical trial produced 6.000 s of callbacks for a nominal 3.000 s CartesianImpedanceMotion duration; future runs use an independent three-second stop

maximum_axial_travel_basis: reuses the physically commissioned CONTACT_SEARCH maximum travel
maximum_lateral_translation_basis: reuses the commissioned bolt free-spin TCP translation guard
maximum_start_lateral_error_basis: preserves the original five-millimeter THREAD_READY start-position allowance but applies it only perpendicular to the screw axis
maximum_start_axial_error_basis: reuses the physically commissioned CONTACT_SEARCH axial travel envelope
trial_count_limit_basis: two captures exist, but the second is excluded for operator-reported initial preload; allow exactly one valid replacement without changing the approved force command

read_only_preview_commissioning.validator_correction: ignore yaw about the screw axis and check only +Kz tool-axis tilt
read_only_preview_commissioning.scope: stationary three-second axial preload only; no rotation, threading, ratchet, release, or camera command
read_only_preview_commissioning.latest_preview_note: Franky 1.1.4 returned an all-zero Jacobian because its wheel loads private libfranka 0.18.0. The direct repository libfranka 0.21.2 diagnostic returned a healthy nonzero Jacobian. This Franky preload path is permanently retired.

direct_libfranka_diagnostic.interpretation: The direct 0.21.2 FR3 model and linear-first wrench ordering are healthy. Contact-critical control must not use the Franky 0.18.0 model wrapper.

direct_low_level_controller.axial_force_ramp_approval: explicit user approval on 2026-08-12; retained for bounded P-only test
direct_low_level_controller.ceiling_characterization_approval: explicit user approval on 2026-08-12 for a 0.500 N/s ramp to 1.500 N followed by a one-second hold
direct_low_level_controller.force_feedback_note: feedback is disabled for ceiling characterization; measured K_F_ext_hat_K[2] minus unloaded baseline is guard/telemetry only
direct_low_level_controller.hold_gain_basis: same stiffness values already physically exercised in the guarded Franky preload trial; critical damping is computed as 2*sqrt(stiffness); screw-axis stiffness and damping are zero
direct_low_level_controller.logging: fixed-capacity real-time buffer written to CSV only after the control loop

direct_low_level_read_only_preview.authorization_scope: one stationary three-second direct-libfranka feedforward axial ramp; no PI feedback, rotation, threading, ratchet, release, Hand command, or collision-setting command

force_command_response_regression.scope: samples above 0.2 N commanded force; diagnostic only

direct_low_level_physical_trial.interpretation: The direct model, 1 kHz control loop, torque mapping, guards, and geometry hold behaved stably, but open-loop feedforward did not achieve the approved measured preload target.
direct_low_level_physical_trial.important_correction: The earlier Franky zero-Jacobian wrapper finding does not explain the under-target force response: the healthy direct libfranka path reproduced approximately the same measured preload. Franky remains rejected for contact-critical work because its exposed model diagnostic is invalid, but the force-response issue is separate.
direct_low_level_physical_trial.required_next_step: design and explicitly approve a bounded measured-force feedback commissioning test; do not increase feedforward by linear extrapolation

bounded_p_only_read_only_preview.execution_note: The live execution preflight must repeat all checks. Do not widen the 5 mm lateral start bound if natural drift causes refusal.
bounded_p_only_read_only_preview.authorization_scope: one stationary three-second bounded P-only axial test; Kp 0.25, Ki 0, 1.500 N command ceiling, 0.500 N/s slew; no rotation, threading, ratchet, release, Hand command, or collision-setting command

comparison_to_feedforward_trial.interpretation: P-only feedback increased response modestly while all motion guards remained far below their limits, but the approved measured target was not approached.

bounded_p_only_physical_trial.required_next_step: characterize the already-approved 1.500 N command ceiling at steady state before selecting integral gain or requesting any higher command ceiling

ceiling_characterization_read_only_previ.authorization_scope: one stationary ceiling-characterization trial: 0 to 1.500 N at 0.500 N/s plus one-second hold; Kp 0, Ki 0; no rotation, threading, ratchet, release, Hand command, or collision-setting command

physical_execution_commissioning.interpretation: the direct Franky force command was stable and guarded but did not produce the approved measured K-frame preload target
physical_execution_commissioning.linear_extrapolation_prohibited: one calibration point is insufficient to justify increasing the command

second_trial.invalid_reason: operator reported the bolt was pushed in hard and not retracted/unloaded after the preceding rotation
second_trial.motion_error: expected libfranka preemption after guard stop

physical_execution_commissioning.decision_basis: Franky 1.1.4 loads private libfranka 0.18.0 and returned an all-zero Jacobian; direct repository libfranka 0.21.2 returned the expected nonzero Jacobian and 0.887504 Nm task-torque norm
physical_execution_commissioning.required_next_controller_if_repeat_remai: direct libfranka 0.21.2 bounded ramped measured-force feedback after explicit gain calibration
